abilities.name: Battle Sense
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Royal Blaze
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 more damage for each Leon card in your discard pile.

abilities.name: Tri Howl
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Vengeance Fletching
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each Ancient card in your discard pile.

abilities.name: Jet Cruise
abilities.effect: Your Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.effect: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Continuous Steps
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Jaw Lock
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Power Blast
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Raging Cannon
attacks.effect: If all your Benched Pokémon have at least 1 damage counter on them, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Laser
attacks.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Let's All Rollout
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has the Let's Rollout Attack.

attacks.name: Dragon Launcher
attacks.effect: Discard a number of your Benched Dreepy up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play. Then, for each Dreepy you discarded in this way, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and do 100 damage to it. You can't choose the same Pokémon more than once. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance

attacks.name: Fickle Impact
attacks.effect: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Moon Mirage
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
